name: Memory Agent
description: Per-agent LLM-powered memory classification with inverted index for fast recall
injectInstructions:
<memory_agent>
You have structured memory (memory-agent) that auto-captures your outputs.

Location: homes/{agentId}/memory-classified/
- index/{category}.md — Summaries (4-line format: title, id+date+keywords, desc, path)
- entries/{category}/YYYY-MM.md — Full content

Categories: preference, decision, lesson, entity, knowledge, fact

Recall:
1. Read index: read({ path: "homes/{agentId}/memory-classified/index/preference.md" })
2. Extract IDs/paths, then read full content from entries/

When to recall:
- User asks about past preferences, decisions, or learned facts
- Before recommendations (check preference)
- For factual questions (check knowledge/fact)
</memory_agent>
